g1.delta: tc.apa_packed.derive_delta(0.01, PACKED_PINNED_ENTRIES["4:D"]) (pinned packed table), raw entry spo2.packed_prefill
g1.inputs: seed SeedSequence([20261116, 1, case index]); q = 3*N(0,1) [B,H,L,D], k, v N(0,1) [B,2,S,D|VD], sinks N(0,1) [H]; bf16 cases round the fp32 draws to bf16 (torch .to)
g1.grid: scripts/apa_p1pf2_gpu.py g1_cases(): the design grid D{64,128} x G{1,2,4,8} x dtype{float32,bfloat16} x B{1,2} x S{255,256,257,2047,2049,8192} x L{2,33,S} x causal x sinks x capacity{S,S+37}, VD = D (4,608 cases); plus D64/VD128 (192 cases: reaches the D64 lane order at G in {1,2}) and D128/VD{256,512} (48 cases: CAP 256/512). KV = 2, H = G*KV.
g1.fp16: not a packed K dtype (apa_spq1_buffer_check refuses fp16 K); fp16 rows are G4 refusal rows, not grid cases.
g1.oracle_rows: every row when S <= 2049; else rows {0,1,255,256,257,2047,2048,2049,L-1} plus 64 rows drawn by SeedSequence([20261116, 7, case index]) without replacement
g1.oracle: spo2.packed_run(q[:,:,i:i+1], k[:,:,:smax_i], v[:,:,:smax_i], same store tuple, scale, same delta, carry="row", diagnostics, dump=True, gqa_path="r2")
g1.pf_i1: mask bytes of prefill row i over keys [0,smax_i) == decode mask, every oracle row of every case, and prefill mask bytes for keys >= smax_i are 0; slack 0
g1.pf_i1_bulk: Build PFH (hooks): prefill bulk [B,H,L,S] fp32 vs decode bulk on uint32 views over [0,smax_i); where B*H*L*S*4 > 2 GiB, row i is run as an L = 1 causal prefill on keys [0,smax_i) (same smax_i and per-row arithmetic); slack 0
g1.ties: tie_cases(): D{64,128} x G{1,2,4,8} x dtype x causal, S 257, L 33, row L-1, head 0; key = first j with 1 < p_j - b_j < 10 in the decode dump; three fp32 deltas with fl(p - delta) == b (expect refined), == nextafter(b,+inf) (expect not), == nextafter(b,-inf) (expect refined); prefill mask == decode mask and both bits as expected
g1.prefix_store: a store filled with only smax keys has codes and norms bitwise equal to the first smax rows of a larger store (D{64,128} x dtype, smax {1,255,1000,2048})
g1.pf_i1n: nonfinite_cases(): D{64,128} x G{1,4} x dtype x causal x L{2,33} x {NaN k, +Inf k, -Inf k, 1e20 k element (overflow), NaN q, NaN v}, S 257 (192 cases). Pass: prefill mask == decode mask on every row; stored norm NaN for the k cases; the set of rows with a non-finite output equals dense SP prefills set (dense quantizer keys, dense table delta, raw dense entry); 0 rows finite where dense is non-finite; at least one non-finite row per case
g1.pf_i2: delta = 1e30 (every key refines; checked: prefill mask == 1 on [0,smax_i) and 0 beyond, dense mask == 1 on [0,smax_i)); prefill out == _C.apa_selective_attention_sp(q, k, kq=k, v, scale, 1e30, causal, sinks, diagnostics) out, same-width integer views; every case; slack 0. Fallback (lead ruling): if the contraction differs, report SASS/PTX cause and hold the PF-I3 tolerance form
g1.pf_i3_tau_rule: tau = min(4 x max over every oracle row of the all-refined comparison ||out_prefill(delta=1e30) - out_decode(delta=1e30)|| / ||out_decode||, 1e-5); then every oracle row at the registered delta: ||out_prefill - out_decode|| <= tau ||out_decode|| per (b,h) row; rows above tau allowed: 0

g2.source: tensor_fork_apa_wt_spq3 artifacts/apa_spq3/captures/<model>/L<nn>_{q,k,v}.npy (bf16 bits, widened exactly to fp32); q [H,S,D], k, v [KV,S,D] -> [1,H,S,D] / [1,KV,S,D]
g2.geometry: S = L = 8192, causal, B 1, no sinks, scale fp32(1/sqrt(128)), epsilon 0.01, fp32

arms.dense: kq = quantize_sp2_keys(k, 4, storage="dense"); apa_selective_attention_sp(q, k, kq, v, scale, 0.01, bulk_bits=4, margins=dense table, is_causal=True, diagnostics=True)
arms.packed: kq = quantize_sp2_keys(k, 4) (shipped default, packed); same call with the pinned packed table; route record must be the prefill backend
arms.exact: _C.apa_selective_attention_sp(q, k, k, v, scale, 1e30, True, None, False): every key scored exactly (fp32 kernel arithmetic)

g2.pf_a1: flips = decisions where the packed mask != the dense mask over causal pairs; N = H*S*(S+1)/2 = 536,936,448 (1.7B) or 1,073,872,896 (4B); bar flips <= 1e-6*N (536 / 1,073)
g2.pf_a2: per row e_SP = ||out_dense - out_exact||, d = ||out_packed - out_dense||, e_A = ||out_packed - out_exact|| (fp64 norms of fp32 outputs); pooled = sqrt(sum of squares over all rows of the layer). Bars: pooled d / pooled e_SP <= 0.02; pooled e_A <= 1.01 pooled e_SP; among rows with e_SP >= 1e-4 ||out_exact||, rows with d > e_SP <= 1e-4 * N_rows (N_rows = 131,072 or 262,144, so <= 13 / 26); every row with e_SP < 1e-4 ||out_exact|| has d <= 1e-4 ||out_exact|| (0 allowed above)
g2.pf_i4: informative: device flip counts against the designs emulated counts (63 / 22 / 91 / 165 at epsilon 0.01)

g3.harness: P1-Q harness imported unchanged (tensor_fork_apa_wt_p1q scripts/apa_p1q_harness.py, apa_p1q_common.py, apa_p1q_tuning.py); this round adds a layer subclass whose L > 1 path (layers >= 1 of the SP arms) calls the public SP route on the chunk (q, the cache prefix k/v as fp32, quantize_sp2_keys(k, 4, storage=<dense|default>), is_causal=True), and a window runner that also keeps the prefill logits

arms.reference: FLASH (exact attention, bf16 SDPA, P1-Qs reference arm)
arms.dense: SP-DENSE (storage="dense"; dense SP prefill and dense SP decode)
arms.packed: SP-PACKED (default packed; packed prefill and packed decode)

populations.prefill: logits at positions S0-1024 .. S0-1 of the prefill (targets ids[pos+1]); N = 10,240 per model
populations.decode: 256 teacher-forced decode steps per window (targets ids[S0+1 .. S0+256]); N = 2,560 per model

g3.metrics: P1-Q common.metrics (AB-1 token_metrics): per-position KL(FLASH||arm) in nats, NLL, top-1 = argmax(arm) == argmax(FLASH)

clauses.top1: count_top1(packed) >= count_top1(dense) - 30 (prefill, N 10,240) or - 7 (decode, N 2,560) (= top1 fraction slack 0.003, one-sided)
clauses.dnll: pooled mean over tokens of nll_packed - nll_dense <= +0.002 nats and the paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound <= +0.005 (P1-Q common.bootstrap_ci: AB-1 percentile bootstrap over windows, 10,000 draws, seed 0)

g3.pass_rule: all three clauses on both populations on both models
g3.timing: one window timed first (L42); projection over the 5-hour GPU cap; RED-BUDGET above it

g5.method: allocator pooling on (tc.set_alloc_pooling(True)) after empty_cache; cudaMemGetInfo used bytes before the call (all inputs, the packed store and its tables resident) and after it with out (and mask) alive: the pool keeps every block the call freed, so after - before is the calls high-water; bound: <= out bytes + mask bytes (if diagnostics) + one allocation granule (P1-D L4s probe, at least 2 MiB); also no allocation of S*D*4 bytes or more beyond out/mask (implied by the bound at the cases below)
g5.cases: geometries H16/KV8/D128 (1.7B) and H32/KV8/D128 (4B); (S, L) in {(2048, 2048), (8192, 8192), (32768, 2048)}; diagnostics off and on (the 4B 8192/8192 diagnostics case allocates a 2 GiB mask)
